_comment: Textures. tiles: block faces, in atlas order. Each tile is { type, ...params }; types: noise, capped, bark, rings, planks, cells, waves, bricks, ore, stripes, blades, stalks, pixelart (palette + rows, "." = transparent), image (a PNG next to this file), layers (stack of the others), ref (reuse another tile). sprites: item icons; tools are drawn automatically from their type and tier.

animations._comment: Tiles that flicker: the engine swaps these frames into the texture atlas at the given speed (frames per second). The first frame is the tile itself.
